notes.title: BubbleByte 🫧🐱 | v1.8.0
notes.content:
Hello folks! 👋

This major update introduces a brand new way of playing the game, designed for those who are craving a more adrenalinic challenge: enter [b]Speedrun Mode[/b]!


[h3]Speedrun Mode[/h3]
[i]Too relaxed? Not enough excitement? This mode is for you![/i]

By visiting the "Data" tab under the "Options" menu, you can now enter Speedrun Mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518205/6dcf8136041b21e34c84a6b0811b9202f078183c.gif[/img]

Entering Speedrun Mode temporarily pauses your current playthrough, and restarts the game from scratch, introducing a new UI with a timer and speedrunning splits at the bottom of the screen.

As soon as you pop the first bubble, the timer begins! This is your cue to play as fast as possible: click quickly but precisely to keep your combos up, and optimize your decision-making to reach your goals as soon as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518205/07e07efc34bc8551f5e9a6f939149e76207ca001.gif[/img]

Improving your clicking accuracy/speed and making better purchase choices are key to succeed in this mode. 

Speedrun playthroughs must be completed in one sitting. Closing the game ends your current speedrun and returns to your main playthrough. You can also return the main playthrough at any point in time by pressing the "End Speerun" button in the "Data" tab.

Note that this mode is completely optional! If speedrunning is not your thing, feel free to ignore it completely.


[h3]Speedrun Mode Achievements[/h3]
[i]Earn your bragging rights![/i]

For the initial release of the Speedrun Mode, I decided to focus the competition on the first and second prestiges (level 2 and level 3). I feel that the game balance up to the second prestige is quite good. Also, I have plans to add some new permanent PP purchases obtainable on the third prestige, so it doesn't make sense to include it in the Speedrun Mode before it gets updated.

I've introduced nine new achievements, all about speedrunning the aforementioned prestige levels:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518205/1a3a8676d33ebd489fb99a2fd7bdd01ab3a2c0a5.png[/img]

Some of these are hard, and will require highly-optimized runs to get -- don't give up!


[h3]Speedrun Leaderboard[/h3]
[i]Compete with other players, officially![/i]

If you want to compete with other players, there is an official [url=https://www.speedrun.com/BubbleByte][b]BubbleByte speedrun.com leaderboard[/b][/url]!

I have already submitted my best times:
- Prestige Lv. 2: 05m14s
- Prestige Lv. 3: 21m52s

Do you think you can beat me? 😁

You can watch my speedrun on YouTube, but don't steal my strategies! 😋

[previewyoutube=ZRpZWQbz7sE;full][/previewyoutube]



[h3]Other Changes[/h3]
[i]There are always some bugs...[/i]

[list]
[*] Fixed tooltips for global Engicat and Mousecat multiplier upgrades not showing "MAX".
[*] Fixed borderless fullscreen mode actually resulting in exclusive fullscreen mode.
[*] Fixed background/music not  automatically switching after completing a shrine after 1st prestige.
[/list]


[h1]Thank you![/h1]

As always, thank you so much for playing and for your extremely valuable feedback!

Please consider leaving a review on the Steam Store yet -- it really helps with BubbleByte's visibility. Also, consider providing feedback in the "Discussions" forum or on the official Discord in order to help make the game even better!

Keep on popping! ❤️


[i](Note: in case of any unexpected bug or issue introduced by the new version, you can always revert to the previous one by selecting the "prev" branch through the game's properties on Steam, in the "Betas" tab.)[/i]


[h2]Bonus (Baby) Byte Photo[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518205/5da9c5baa357c1c1f8bfb45a55e270b16d4cbb1c.png[/img]

notes.title: BubbleByte 🫧🐱 | v1.7.0
notes.content:
Hello! 👋 
Here's a cleanup/polish patch addressing recent feedback and fixing some annoying bugs.


[h2]Undo PP Purchases[/h2]
[i]Misclicked, changed your mind, or just wanted to see if you could afford it? No worries![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518205/373ce7fa9d72cfc742707c189cc7aa6fbdacc4ef.png[/img]
[list]
[*] There is now a 10s grace period to undo any permanent prestige point purchase.
[*] It is possible to undo multiple times in a row.
[*] Any achievement related to PP purchases will not be unlocked during the undo grace period.
[/list]


[h2]Achievement Improvements[/h2]
[i]No more out-of-sync achievements nor guessing your progress![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518205/688c0140160ad36bc46aa771030389a02d54dc88.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added a checkbox to the in-game achievement browser to show/hide completed achievements.
[*] In-game achievements are now synced with Steam achievements on start-up.
[*] Progress for most achievements is now displayed in-game.
[*] Changed the count of Astrocats required to unlock the relevant achievements from [1, 5, 10, 20, 30, 40] to [1, 5, 10, 20, 25, 30] to bring the difficulty more in line with other achievements.
[/list]


[h2]Polish & Bugfixes[/h2]
[i]Many little improvements add up![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518205/8e4c2ac8d51dcfdc7a108fa63b6dcf859cf705f8.png[/img]
[list]
[*] It is now possible to bulk-purchase PPs once you reach the maximum prestige level.
[*] In addition to LShift, LCtrl can now be used to select multiple cats at once.
[*] Attempting to select multiple cats near the edge of the map will now automatically scroll.
[*] Added ability to hide maxed-out purchasables and category separators in shop ("Interface" tab).
[*] Added a "SFX" volume control slider that only affects sounds.
[*] Spells can now upgraded with wisdom points while the Wizardcat is busy (e.g. absorbing wisdom).
[*] The wisdom point counter in the "Magic" menu now uses digit separators for easier readability.
[*] Long button labels are now scaled to avoid the text going out of bounds.
[*] Tooltips for maxed-out purchased will now show "MAX" instead of calculating one more value.
[*] The recently added Multipop circle range indicator is now hidden while dragging cats.
[*] Improved layout of the "Statistics" tab to avoid very large numbers from being cut off.
[*] Sligthly increased menu scrollbar thickness. 
[*] Slightly increased default cursor scale.
[*] On a Steam Deck, cats now spawn in the middle of the screen again (better for touch screens).
[*] Fixed a crash related to the Wizardcat's Mewltiplier Aura spell -- sorry if encountered this issue!
[*] Fixed "remember to buy combo upgrade" tip unexpectedly showing up after prestiging.
[*] Fixed "horizontal stripe" rendering artifact on bubbles, especially visible at low resolutions.
[/list]


[h1]Thank you![/h1]

Please keep the feedback coming, we really appreciate it! 

If you have not left a review on the Steam Store yet, please consider doing so -- it really helps with BubbleByte's visibility. Also, please consider leaving feedback in the "Discussions" forum or [url=https://discord.me/bubblebyte]on the official Discord[/url] in order to make the game even better!

Keep on popping! ❤️

[i](Note: in case of any unexpected bug or issue introduced by the new version, you can always revert to the previous one by selecting the "prev" branch through the game's properties on Steam, in the "Betas" tab.)[/i]


[h2]Bonus Byte Photo[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518205/2eebb2e882ef0e04045130b121b705f98314950c.png[/img]

notes.title: BubbleByte 🫧🐱 | v1.6.0
notes.content:
Hello folks! 👋

This major update improves many different aspects of the game, and it's all thanks to your fantastic constructive feedback.

Please keep the feedback coming -- Sonia (the artist) and I read every single post and every single review, and want to make the game more enjoyable for everyone.


[h3]Mouse Cursor Enhancements[/h3]
[i]No more losing track of your combos or cursor in a sea of bubbles![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518205/dead868f4bbef6b43869add4f5e311080e161b89.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Added a combo bar next to the cursor (can be toggled in "Interface").
[*] Added a plus sign to the cursor texture when Multipop is active.
[*] Added a subtle circle indicator that shows Multipop's range when active.
[*] Added a subtle drop shadow effect to the mouse cursor.
[*] Slightly increased the default cursor scale.
[*] Cursor combo text and combo bar are not displayed when dragging cats anymore.
[/list]


[h3]Better Cat Dragging/Placement[/h3]
[i]New cat arrivals messing up your meticolously placed feline formations is a thing of the past.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518205/d01810f01f340235e1892adc4377778ececf36a0.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Newly purchased cats are now placed by players instead of appearing in the middle of the screen.
[*] Dragging multiple cats at once is much more intuitive now, either left shift or LMB can be released.
[*] The Wizardcat can now be dragged while absorbing wisdom or casting spells.
[*] Added a tip explaining how to drag multiple cats at once (appears upon purchasing your 3rd cat).
[/list]



[h3]Map Navigation Controls[/h3]
[i]Exploring the map used to be unintuitive and slow -- not anymore![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518205/f26746ff2f3293086523cc005d2ee5617f3bf8ff.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Clicking on the minimap will now scroll to the clicked location.
[*] The scroll wheel can now be used to scroll the map (if not hovering UI).
[*] The A/D keys can now be used to scroll the map (in addition to LeftArrow/RightArrow).
[*] Holding Left Shift while scrolling the map will double the scrolling speed.
[*] The Home/End keys can now be used to immediately jump to the beginning/end of the map, respectively.
[*] The PageUp/PageDown keys can now be used to jump to the previous/next shrine, respectively.
[/list]


[h3]New Player Experience Improvements[/h3]
[i]Missed a tip and not sure what to do next? I've got the solution.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518205/26e7dc034e5531a24bf718d40e73d70d3a263f4e.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added text under inactive shrine to remind players how to activate/complete them (visible only during 1st prestige).
[*] Slightly increased tip duration, and duration now scales with the length of the tip text.
[*] Updated tips to reflect newly added shortcuts and features.
[*] Renamed the "Stats" menu to "Info" and added new "Tips" tab containing useful tips.
[/list]


[h3]Keyboard Shortcuts[/h3]
[i]When speedrunning the game or just wanting to navigate the UI faster, keyboard shortcuts are a must![/i]

[list]
[*] The Y key can now be used to pop bubbles (for QWERTZ users, with love).
[*] Menu tabs can be switched using the 1-5 numeric keys.
[*] The menu can be minimized by using the Backslash/Tilde key (to the left of number 1).
[/list]


[h3]More Customization Options[/h3]
[i]Everybody wants the game just a little bit different, and I'm fine with that! [/i]

[list]
[*] Added an option to toggle the cat bobbing/floating animation in the "Graphics" tab.
[*] Added an option to increase cat range outline thickness in the "Graphics" tab.
[*] Added an option to toggle the screen shake effect both in the quick settings menu and in the "Graphics" tab.
[/list]


[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[i]There are always some to squash...[/i]

[list]
[*] Fixed Mousecat Multipop state being reset to while prestiging.
[*] Fixed Astrocats losing their initial position after a flyby -- formations should now be stable.
[*] Fixed cats colliding with shrines while being dragged and ruining your formations.
[*] Fixed typos in several tips/tooltips.
[*] Fixed a secret achievement incorrectly unlocking when prestiging.
[*] Minor sprite art cleanup/improvements.
[/list]


[h3]Future Plans[/h3]

There still are quite a few things that could be improved, especially in the late-game. This is a list of what I'm exploring/experimenting with for future updates:

[list]
[*] Adding more unique prestige points rewards, such as a "laser cursor" that can be held down to pop bubbles automatically. I have already implemented this, but I am thinking about how to make it more fun to use, perhaps by having a "charge/battery" system that needs to be charged via normal combos and unleashed at will.
[*] Adding more interactions between late-game cats. I am experimenting with buffing Astrocats when they touch a Devilcat portal.
[*] Adding more content at the end of the game. After your unlock the final special "cat", there's not much left to discover. I do want BubbleByte to have a definite ending, but I think it would also be nice to have something extra for players who want to push the game to its limits.
[*] Buffing clicking in the late game. The "laser cursor" is one of the ideas, but I'm also experimenting with other ones, such as being able to give cats treats by clicking on them to speed them up or temporarily buff them.
[*] Adding a built-in speedrunning mode with splits that can be entered whenever you want without losing progress in the main game. 
[*] Tweaking end-game balance of the Mousecat, it seems a little bit too powerful at the moment, and surrounding it with cats isn't the most creative/clever formation.
[*] Adding some sort of "beacon" cat (a la Factorio) that needs to be surrounded by exactly N other cats to provide a buff/effect -- this would make late-game formations more spread out and interesting.
[*] Adding dynamic visual decorations for unique cats. The Wizardcat could have a moving cape, the Engicat could have a tesla coil attached to their body, and so on... Sonia will have more stuff to draw!
[*] Better Steam Deck support.
[*] Adding more secret/challenging achievements that require you to play the game in a different way. Perhaps even starting parallel playthroughs with interesting restrictions!
[/list]


[h1]Thank you![/h1]

I would like to reiterate our appreciation for the feedback we received. We did not expect to see this amount of thorough, fair, and actionable feedback -- the game is improving thanks to you!

If you have not left a review on the Steam Store yet, please consider doing so -- it really helps with BubbleByte's visibility. Also, please consider leaving feedback in the "Discussions" forum or on the official Discord in order to make the game even better!

Keep on popping! ❤️


[i](Note: in case of any unexpected bug or issue introduced by the new version, you can always revert to the previous one by selecting the "prev" branch through the game's properties on Steam, in the "Betas" tab.)[/i]

notes.title: BubbleByte 🫧🐱 | v1.5.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I have received some very kind, thoughtful, and actionable feedback lately, and I've been doing my best to improve the BubbleByte experience for everyone.

This patch introduces a few major changes that should make prestige feel more impactful early on, and give players who prefer a more idle playstyle more options to succeed.



[h2]Prestige Scaling Rework[/h2]

Some players felt that prestiging, especially early on, did not feel very impactful. I played the game from the very beginning a few more times and I agree that the prestige system as a whole should feel more rewarding.

As a result, I've made a few changes:

[list]
[*] Changed PPs (prestige points) reward formula from (2 ^ prestigeLevel) to (2 ^ (prestigeLevel + 1)).
[*] Added a new "Autocast" prestige reward, costing 4PPs.
[*] Decreased the cost of "Selective Starpaw" from 8PPs to 4PPs.
[/list]

In practice, this means that the pacing of the game will be sligthly faster, and -- most importantly -- the second prestige will feel much more impactful and give the player plenty of choice.

[h3]1st Prestige[/h3]

By design, the first prestige drives the player towards purchasing smart cats, as it's a fundamental upgrade to start building chains with Devilcats. This is mostly unchanged, but the player can now afford to upgrade the Witchcat's ritual duration once as well.

[h3]2nd Prestige[/h3]

Previously, you couldn't do much in the 2nd prestige -- this was a major oversight on my part, and I apologize! With this patch, players will have 4PPs available to spend, and there now are plenty of choices:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518205/13f03ef63d7af0ccae910f4734b30bfbc7d77ff0.png[/img]

Depending on your playstyle, you might want to:
[list]
[*] Unseal the witch to more quickly start benefiting from ritual buffs.
[*] Improve ritual length significantly with either "Group Ritual" or "Worldwide Cult".
[*] Pick up "Autocast" to let the Wizardcat cast spells automatically if you prefer an idle playstyle.
[*] Pick up "Selective Starpaw" if you want to actively maximize bomb explosion value with star bubbles.
[*] Pick up other smaller upgrades if you want to specialize in Unicat ritual buffs, or have more mana available and actively cast spells yourself.
[/list]

I think this is a huge improvement from before -- eager to know what you think!

[h3]Prestige Point Compensation[/h3]

Player with existing saved playthrough need not to worry -- when you boot up the game, you will receive the "missing" prestige points that you should have had at this point if you had started playing with the new formula:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518205/cc5e1ddc7a9acac7e9390d555d96b1653dedefd9.png[/img]



[h2]Autocast[/h2]

The new prestige reward "Autocast", purchasable for 4PP after unsealing the Wizardcat for the first time, adds a new section in the "Magic" menu that allows the player to pick a spell to be casted automatically. Ideal for players who prefer an idle playstyle but still want to make use of the Wizardcat's powers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518205/221dcb65d037e649c42b117206085a12a8b2f46a.png[/img]



[h2]Accessibility Improvements[/h2]

Some players were accidentally dragging cats around when clicking bubbles. I've slightly increased the amount of time required to start dragging cats while holding the mouse button, and also added an option for people to tweak the timer themselves:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518205/5011a2b051095304058a1d6468c9804295a52259.png[/img]

Additionally, some other players felt like clicking with the mouse button could cause wrist fatigue. I am experimenting with ideas to make this better, but I'd like to remind players that it is currently possible to "click" by pressing either the Z or X keys on your keyboard. With this technique, you can "aim" using the mouse, but avoid the wrist fatigue of clicking by using your other hand to press Z or X.

Suggestions on how to improve accessibility even further are more than welcome!



[h1]Thank you![/h1]

I'd like to thank everyone for playing BubbleByte and providing their valuable feedback. My girlfriend and I are very happy to see that players are enjoying our game (she drew all the cute cats). 

I strongly encourage fans of BubbleByte to leave a Steam review to help us out with visibility on the store, and to leave feedback in the "Discussions" forum or on the official Discord in order to improve the game and make it even more enjoyable.

I have plans for future major upgrades that hopefully you will enjoy -- I will share more about them once they become somewhat more concrete.

Keep on popping! <3



[i](Note: in case of any unexpected bug or issue introduced by the new version, you can always revert to the previous one by selecting the "prev" branch through the game's properties on Steam, in the "Betas" tab.)[/i]

[/list]

Bring on the heat!

notes.title: BubbleByte 🫧🐱 | v1.3.0
notes.content:
Bugfixes and QoL improvements for completionists!

[list]
[*] "Transcendent Unicats" and "Hellsigned Devilcats" permanent upgrades can now be toggled at will after purchasing. This allows achievements relying on star bubbles and bombs to be always completed, and to experiment with different cat setups even in late game.
[*] Added a prestige point sink after reaching max prestige level.
[*] Fixed "Pawdestination" achievement not unlocking even when requirements were met.
[*] Fixed prestige session statistics not being correctly reset after prestiging.
[*] Fixed missing names for some Witchcat achievements.
[*] A secret achievement is now obtainable even after prestiging. If you are already at the max prestige level, you can reset the current prestige session from the "Data" tab in the settings.
[*] Removed hidden unused achievements -- the total count of achievements should be correct now!
[/list]

notes.title: BubbleByte 🫧🐱 | v1.2.0
notes.content:
Hey! Here's another minor patch with mostly QoL improvements:

[list]
[*] The keys Z or X on the keyboard can now also be used to click -- your wrists will thank you!
[*] Added a graphical effect around the screen when there are dolls to collect. This can be disabled in the "Graphics" options tab.
[*] Increased camera scrolling speed when dragging cats near edges.
[*] Increased costs of Repulsocat and Attractocat shrines/upgrades to bring them more in line with the expected income at the point of the game.
[*] Dolls do not spawn under the menu UI anymore.
[*] Dolls do not spawn exactly on top of cats anymore (but can still spawn near them).
[/list]

I also hosted a BubbleByte speedrunning tournament at my local gaming hall (Redshift Gaming) yesterday night -- congratulations to Andrea, Carmelo, and Marco for winning the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place prizes!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QSmiRFN.jpeg[/img]

notes.title: BubbleByte 🫧🐱 | v1.1.0
notes.content:
Hello! This version introduces some minor balance changes, some QoL features/options, and a few fixes.

[list]
[*] Unicat "Transcendence" permanent upgrade is now slightly cheaper.
[*] Unicat range upgrades are now enabled only after "Nova Expanse" is purchased.
[*] The camera will now automatically scroll when dragging cats near the edge.
[*] Multiple cats can be dragged at once using Left Shift.
[*] The highest $/s reached is now tracked under the "Stats" tab.
[*] The mana required for Wizardcat spells is now displayed in the "Remember Spell" tooltip, so that you don't waste wisdom points.
[*] Prevent clicks done on top of UI from being registered in the game.
[*] Prevent cats from being grabbed while off-screen.
[*] Shrine text is now always displayed in front of other game elements.
[*] Added an option to invert the functionality of the left and right mouse buttons.
[*] Added a new "Data" tab under "Settings" that allows your profile to be reset, useful for speedrunning.
[*] Fixed the game crashing on startup under Proton/Wine. Steam Deck needs some attention still, will try to implement support next week!
[/list]

Thank you everyone for playing, I hope you are enjoying BubbleByte so far! <3

notes.title: BubbleByte v1.0.2
